items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Eddie Chiri. Oh yes. Eddie Chiri. He was playing clarinet the saxophone at the time.

ctx.x: Did Sam Dutre play up in the plane? Did he go up and was he in the band then?
No, he wasn't with us, but I'm trying to. Eddie Chiri. Oh yes. Eddie Chiri. He was playing clarinet the saxophone at the time.

I was going to ask about this picture over here that you showed us the other day. With this group with Pierone and Benton and St. Cyr. I have a copy of this picture. But you said they were going to go on the road for some reason.
